description: The objectives are to know about power devices, the methods of turning them ON and OFF, and their connections in circuits to control and convert power.

syllabus.title: Modern Power Electronic Devices
syllabus.body: Principle of operation of SCR, dynamic characteristic of SCR during turn ON and turn OFF, two transistor analogy, protection of SCR, snubber circuit, commutation circuits, SCR ratings, triggering methods, series and parallel operation of SCR. Principle of operation of IGBT, GTO, MCT, DIAC, TRIAC and IGCT, and their operating characteristics.

syllabus.title: Single-Phase Converter
syllabus.body: Half-wave converter, 2-pulse midpoint converter, half-controlled and fully-controlled bridge converters, input current and output voltage waveforms, effect of load and source impedance, expressions for input power factor, displacement factor, harmonic factor and output voltage, effect of free-wheeling diode, triggering circuits, dual converter.

syllabus.title: Three-Phase Converter
syllabus.body: Half wave, full wave, half controlled and fully controlled bridge converters, effect of load and source impedance, expressions for input power factor, displacement factor, harmonic factor and output voltage, dual converter.

syllabus.title: AC Converters
syllabus.body: Principle of operation of single-phase AC regulator, effect of load inductance, firing pulse requirement. Principle of operation of cyclo-converter, waveforms, control technique. Application of converters in industries.

outcomes: Understand fundamental concepts in power electronics.
Identify basic requirements for power electronics-based design and application.
textbooks: M. Ramamoorthy, Thyristor and their Applications, East West Publication, 1991.
P. S. Bhimbra, Power Electronics, Khanna Publishers, 2015.
M. D. Singh and K. B. Khanchandani, Power Electronics, TMH Edition, 2007.
referenceBooks: G. K. Dubey, S. R. Doradla, A. Joshi and R. M. K. Sinha, Thyristorised Power Controllers, New Age International Private Ltd.
N. Mohan, T. M. Undeland and W. P. Robbins, Power Electronics: Converters, Applications and Design, 3rd Edition, Wiley India.
